SELECT user_info.id, user_info.org_id, organize.name AS org_name, user_info.account, user_info.username, user_info.avatar, user_info.sex, user_info.enabled,
COALESCE( ( SELECT STRING_AGG( post_info.name, '、' ORDER BY post_info.sort_order, post_info.id ) FROM sys_user_post user_post JOIN sys_post post_info ON post_info.id = user_post.post_id WHERE user_post.user_id = user_info.id ), '' ) AS post_names,
user_info.built_in, user_info.remark, user_info.created_at
FROM sys_user user_info
LEFT JOIN sys_organize organize ON organize.id = user_info.org_id
AND user_info.account ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{account}, '%')
AND user_info.org_id = #{orgId}
ORDER BY user_info.created_at DESC, user_info.id DESC

SELECT user_info.id, user_info.account, user_info.username, user_info.org_id, organize.name AS org_name, user_info.avatar, user_info.sex, user_info.email, user_info.mobile, user_info.enabled, user_info.built_in, user_info.remark, user_info.created_at, user_info.updated_at
FROM sys_user user_info
LEFT JOIN sys_organize organize ON organize.id = user_info.org_id
WHERE user_info.id = #{id}

SELECT post_info.id AS post_id, post_info.name AS post_name
FROM sys_user_post user_post
JOIN sys_post post_info ON post_info.id = user_post.post_id
WHERE user_post.user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY post_info.sort_order, post_info.id
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role user_role JOIN sys_role role_info ON role_info.id = user_role.role_id WHERE user_role.user_id = #{userId} AND role_info.status = TRUE )

SELECT user_info.id FROM sys_user user_info
WHERE user_info.id IN
#{userId}
AND user_info.enabled = TRUE
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role user_role
JOIN sys_role role_info ON role_info.id = user_role.role_id
WHERE user_role.user_id = user_info.id
AND role_info.status = TRUE )
ORDER BY user_info.id
